title: Integrals over C¹-close bi-Lipschitz images of a compact parameter set converge
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Amb n ℓ) and H := μHE[n], the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure on E. Let K ⊆ ℝⁿ (Rn n) be compact, let pr : E → ℝⁿ and L : ℝⁿ → E be continuous linear maps with pr(L v) = v for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, let F : ℝ → (ℝⁿ → E) be an arbitrary family of maps (F_t := F t; no continuity is assumed), and let φ : E → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Assume, as t → 0+ (along 𝓝[>] 0): (H1) eventually pr(F_t v) = v for all v ∈ K; (H2) for every ε > 0, eventually ‖F_t v − F_t v' − L(v − v')‖ ≤ ε‖v − v'‖ for all v, v' ∈ K; (H3) for every ε > 0, eventually ‖F_t v − L v‖ ≤ ε for all v ∈ K. Then ∫_{F_t(K)} φ dH → ∫_{L(K)} φ dH as t → 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)) (pr : Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Rn n) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (F : ℝ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (φ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ), IsCompact K → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ v, pr (L v) = v) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ v ∈ K, pr (F t v) = v) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ v ∈ K, ∀ v' ∈ K, ‖F t v - F t v' - L (v - v')‖ ≤ ε * ‖v - v'‖) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∀ v ∈ K, ‖F t v - L v‖ ≤ ε) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ∫ w in F t '' K, φ w ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ w in L '' K, φ w ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))))
